steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Hold the word MOM up to a mirror. What does it say?
points: Hold the word MOM up to a mirror. What does it say?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: A mirror flips left and right.
Letters that look the same flipped stay the same.
points: A mirror flips left and right.

steps.title: The method: Flip in your mind
sentences: The letters M, O and T look the same when flipped.
In a mirror the word also reads from the other side.
So MOM and TOT stay the same.
points: The letters M, O and T look the same when flipped.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: MOM and TOT look the same in a mirror.
Letters like B or R flip to look back to front.
points: MOM and TOT look the same in a mirror.
